remainingWeaknesses: Vista publishes model-specific thermal ratings only for Capri 3.0 in the current captured document set; equivalent Amalfi, Aria, and Rimini performance tables remain unavailable.
The current downloads-page prose incorrectly calls the Aria 1.0 brochure Aria 2.0; stronger canonical and document identity evidence resolves it to Aria 1.0, but the supplier typo remains live.
The Genius warranty is image-only. OCR recovered 3,555 characters and is provenance-tagged, but OCR-derived terms remain reviewable evidence rather than independently authored catalogue copy.
Two current documents are intentionally supplier-shared without product attachment: the ODL mini-blind warranty and security-film feature sheet lack a sufficiently explicit model relationship.

Vista links installation videos, including supplier-hosted MP4 and YouTube sources. The existing ingestion architecture deliberately excludes video binaries; those links remain uncaptured reference media.
Several installation PDFs contain noisy embedded text ordering and source misspellings. Visual page review passed and extraction recorded no fatal errors.
